```yaml
name: Merge Queue Cleanup

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/5 * * * *'  # every 5 minutes
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  cleanup:
    if: github.repository == 'nexi-lab/nexus'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Clean UNMERGEABLE entries from merge queue
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import os, sys, requests, json

          token = os.getenv('GITHUB_TOKEN')
          repo = os.getenv('GITHUB_REPOSITORY')
          owner, name = repo.split('/')

          headers = {
              'Authorization': f'token {token}',
              'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json',
              'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28'
          }

          # Query merge queue entries
          query = """
          {
            repository(owner: "%s", name: "%s") {
              mergeQueue {
                entries {
                  pullRequest {
                    number
                    id
                    title
                    author {
                      login
                    }
                  }
                  status
                }
              }
            }
          }
          """ % (owner, name)

          resp = requests.post('https://api.github.com/graphql', json={'query': query}, headers=headers)
          resp.raise_for_status()
          data = resp.json()
          entries = data['data']['repository']['mergeQueue']['entries']

          removed_any = False

          for entry in entries:
              if entry['status'] == 'UNMERGEABLE':
                  pr = entry['pullRequest']
                  pr_id = pr['id']
                  pr_number = pr['number']

                  # Remove from merge queue
                  mutation = """
                  mutation ($pullRequestId: ID!) {
                    removeFromMergeQueue(input: {pullRequestId: $pullRequestId}) {
                      clientMutationId
                    }
                  }
                  """
                  variables = {'pullRequestId': pr_id}
                  resp2 = requests.post('https://api.github.com/graphql', json={'query': mutation, 'variables': variables}, headers=headers)
                  resp2.raise_for_status()

                  # Post comment
                  comment_body = (
                      f"⚠️ This PR was automatically removed from the merge queue because it was marked **UNMERGEABLE**. "
                      f"Please rebase and re-open the PR to re-add it to the queue."
                  )
                  comment_resp = requests.post(
                      f'https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{name}/issues/{pr_number}/comments',
                      json={'body': comment_body},
                      headers=headers
                  )
                  comment_resp.raise_for_status()

                  print(f"Removed PR #{pr_number} from merge queue and commented.")
                  removed_any = True

          if not removed_any:
              print("No UNMERGEABLE entries found.")
              sys.exit(0)
          PY
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
